notes.title: Upcoming Release - Catch Love and Laughter with 'Sushi for Empress Setsuko'
notes.notes:
[img]https://clan.akamai.steamstatic.com/images/44530176/d99ed40556b66a0d5543034397f6f7ada34601d6.png[/img]

Hey there, Mew gamers! We're thrilled to announce the upcoming release of our latest game, "Sushi for Empress Setsuko." 

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2593940/Sushi_for_Empress_Setsuko/?curator_clanid=44530176

Join Mizumi Nagashima in this cozy fishing adventure as she navigates life's storms. Her fishing boat took a hit, and she's on a mission to catch fish for Empress Setsuko to make ends meet.

This ain't your typical fishing game; it's a mix of yuri dating, point-and-click adventure, and fantastical Japan-inspired scenery that'll leave you in awe.

🌸 Explore breathtaking Medieval Japan-inspired landscapes.
😂 Get ready for an exciting and comedic storyline.
❤️ Meet multiple romanceable waifus on your journey.
🎶 Immerse yourself in a fusion of New Age and Japanese traditional music.

Will Mizumi make the Empress smile with her sushi? Can she fix her beloved fishing boat? Will she find love along the way?

Get ready for an unforgettable adventure filled with love, laughter, and delicious fish. "Sushi for Empress Setsuko" is coming soon, so stay tuned for the release date! 🍣🗾🌟
